title: Cosmic Poppy Bloom
description: A close-up of vibrant red and orange poppies with large green leaves and purple stems, set against a dark cosmic background filled with glowing golden particles and stars. Intricate golden filigree and mandala-like patterns overlay the lower leaves and flowers.
